meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use null for max to mean no upper bound. A number always means that number — there is no magic threshold. (999 is still read as no-bound for older files, but is deprecated: write null.)

general.description: Fungal macro-organisms that grow on airless planetary surfaces with volcanic activity. They form tubular, branching surface structures that represent only the exposed portion of a larger subsurface organism. Their morphology varies significantly based on volcanism type and planetary composition.
environmental_context: Found exclusively on airless volcanic bodies
Often appear in clustered fields near lava or silicate activity zones
Surface structures are fungal projections of a larger subterranean organism

special_rules: NO atmosphere is mandatory for all species
Volcanism is the primary driver of species variation
Species can overlap across planet types depending on geology
Minimum sample distance is 100m due to dense clustering behavior
Distribution is strongly biased toward Galactic Core regions
Color variation is dependent on mineral composition and volcanism type
Surface structures represent only the visible portion of a subsurface organism
Multiple species can appear on the same planetary body under different geological zones
